test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(a) the use of animal research

(b) throughout the past century

(c) and it continues to be used to understand many diseases

(d) has been of considerable importance

(e) in the field of scientific and medical advancements
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **adebc**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "**a"** the use of animal research" which introduces the main subject.
 
• Following it, "**d"** has been of considerable importance" explains the significance of the use of animal research.
 
• **"e"** in the field of scientific and medical advancements" specifies the area where it has been important.
 
• **"b"** throughout the past century" provides the time frame during which it has been important.
 
• **"c"** and it continues to be used to understand many diseases" completes the sentence by explaining its ongoing usage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **adebc.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (aecdb):** This option starts with "the use of animal research in the field of scientific and medical advancements," which places the context before establishing the importance, making it less coherent.
 
• **Option 2 (ecdba):** This option disrupts the logical flow by starting with the context before addressing the main subject and its importance.
 
• **Option 4 (edcba):** This option starts with "in the field of scientific and medical advancements has been of considerable importance the use of animal research," which is grammatically incorrect and lacks logical flow.
